name: 9th Kup

practical.title: Walking stance: low block / rising block

theory.question: What is the meaning of the yellow belt?
theory.answer: Yellow stands for the earth, where a plant puts down roots; it reflects the foundation being laid in Tae Kwon-Do.

theory.question: What is 'Waving kick' in Korean? (quiz widget)

otherSections.heading: Chon-Ji pattern summary
items: 19 movements; Heaven and Earth, the first pattern for beginners, in two similar parts.
Starts in parallel ready stance facing line D from line AB.
Alternating walking stances with low blocks and middle punches; L-stance middle blocks at movements 9, 11, 13 and 15; movements 17 to 19 are punches toward D.
Ends by returning the left foot to ready posture.
